info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Marketing Prospect Campaign Design Retrieval API enables users to access detailed marketing campaign designs based on specified parameters. This API serves to enhance marketing strategies by allowing businesses to fetch tailored campaign data that can optimize customer engagement. Typical consumers include marketing teams and data analysts who utilize this endpoint to inform decision-making processes with precise campaign insights. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve targeting and efficiency in their marketing efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve a prospect campaign design by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details of a specific prospect campaign design using its unique identifier. It provides all relevant information needed to review or analyze the campaign design.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving prospect campaign design details. This should include all parameters necessary for the request to be processed accurately.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the prospect campaign design data.

GetMarketingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the marketing prospect campaign design operation.

targetSegmentId.description: Identifier for the target audience segment for the campaign.

channelMix.description: List of communication channels used in the campaign.

items.description: A single communication channel used for the campaign.

startDate.description: The start date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: The end date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.

campaignObjective.description: The primary objective of the campaign.

controlGroupPercent.description: Percentage of the target audience that will be used as a control group.

contactFrequencyCap.description: Maximum number of times a contact can be reached within the campaign timeline.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the campaign record (e.g., active, archived).

version.description: Version number of the campaign record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update made to the campaign record.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the campaign response.

GetMarketingByParam1Response_200.description: Represents the response structure for a campaign design query in the marketing operations.

amount.description: The total budget amount allocated for the campaign.

currency.description: The currency in which the budget is specified.

Budget.description: Represents the budget details for a campaign.

correlationId.description: Identifier used for tracing requests across services.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographical region where the request was processed.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata for tracking and correlation purposes.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method utilizing JWT (JSON Web Tokens). Clients must provide a valid JWT token in the Authorization header to access secured endpoints.
